name: io.github.PacketFabric/packetfabric-mcp
title: PacketFabric
description: Query and manage PacketFabric NaaS: ports, virtual circuits, cloud routers, pricing, metrics.

environmentVariables.name: PF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: PacketFabric API key (portal: Settings > API Keys). Optional: pricing and location lookups work without it

environmentVariables.name: PF_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow create/modify/delete calls (each still needs confirm=true)

environmentVariables.name: PF_ON_BEHALF
environmentVariables.description: Resellers only: customer UUID to act on behalf of

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your PacketFabric API key>. Optional: pricing and location lookups work without it
